schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

## Lemmy — a link aggregator for the fediverse (Rust backend + dev Postgres).
## `flox activate` gives you the pinned Rust toolchain, the native build inputs
## Cargo needs (libpq for pq-sys/diesel, a C compiler, pkg-config), diesel-cli,
## and a local dev Postgres service. `flox activate --start-services` also boots
## the database. Build/run with `cargo run --features full`.

[install]
# --- Rust toolchain (rust-toolchain.toml pins channel "1.95"; edition 2024) ---
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.version = "1.95.0"
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.version = "1.95.0"
# clippy/rustfmt only exist at 1.96.1 in the catalog and have no x86_64-darwin
# build — see options.systems below. Left unpinned (dev-lint tooling).
clippy.pkg-path = "clippy"
rustfmt.pkg-path = "rustfmt"

# --- Native build inputs for `cargo build` ---
# pq-sys (Cargo.lock, via diesel "postgres") links libpq -> postgresql dev+lib.
# gcc is the linker + builds the cc/vendored crates (zstd-sys, tikv-jemalloc-sys,
# ring). No openssl: Cargo.lock has no openssl-sys (the Dockerfile's runner-stage
# libssl-dev is runtime-only, not a build input).
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
# postgresql_18 = libpq (dev headers + lib) for the build AND the dev DB server
# binaries (initdb/pg_ctl/psql/createdb/pg_dump). dev+lib aren't default outputs.
postgresql_18.pkg-path = "postgresql_18"
postgresql_18.outputs = ["out", "dev", "lib"]

# --- Diesel schema/migration tooling (diesel.toml; scripts/update_schema_file.sh) ---
diesel-cli.pkg-path = "diesel-cli"

# --- Used by repo helper scripts (e.g. scripts/start_dev_db.sh URL-encodes a path) ---
jq.pkg-path = "jq"

[vars]
# Matches config/defaults.hjson `connection` and CI's LEMMY_DATABASE_URL.
# The env var overrides the hjson config, so the backend connects with no edits.
LEMMY_DATABASE_URL = "postgres://lemmy:password@127.0.0.1:5432/lemmy"
# Convenience for a bare `psql` inside the environment.
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "lemmy"
PGDATABASE = "lemmy"
RUST_BACKTRACE = "1"

[hook]
on-activate = """
  # Keep all Cargo build state in the Flox cache, NOT the repo's ./target tree.
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/target"
  mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"

  # One-time dev Postgres cluster in the Flox cache (trust auth, dev-only).
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" --username=postgres --auth=trust --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-p ${PGPORT} -k /tmp -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1" \
      -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    PGUSER=postgres PGDATABASE=postgres psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -q \
      -c "CREATE USER lemmy WITH PASSWORD 'password' SUPERUSER;" >&2
    PGUSER=postgres PGDATABASE=postgres createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -O lemmy lemmy >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi
"""

[profile]
bash = 'export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"'
zsh  = 'export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"'
fish = 'set -x CARGO_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; fish_add_path "$CARGO_HOME/bin"'

[services.postgres]
# Dev database. Start with `flox activate --start-services` or `flox services start postgres`.
# (dev-only trust auth — not safe for shared machines)
command = """
  exec postgres -D "$PGDATA" -p "$PGPORT" -k /tmp -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1
"""

[options]
# clippy and rustfmt have no x86_64-darwin build in the catalog (only 1.96.1,
# which excludes it), so scope the environment to the three systems every pinned
# package supports: Apple Silicon + both Linux architectures. Intel-Mac devs can
# add clippy/rustfmt via rustup.
systems = ["aarch64-darwin", "aarch64-linux", "x86_64-linux"]

## Flox Environment Manifest -----------------------------------------
##
##   _Everything_ you need to know about the _manifest_ is here:
##
##   https://flox.dev/docs/reference/command-reference/manifest.toml/
##
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify


## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
[install]
# --- Rust toolchain -------------------------------------------------
# Pinned to 1.95 per rust-toolchain.toml (channel = "1.95"); also the
# newest build still published for all four platforms — 1.96.x drops
# x86_64-darwin. cargo/rustc/clippy/rustfmt stay version-coherent.
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.version = "1.95.0"
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.version = "1.95.0"
clippy.pkg-path = "clippy"
clippy.version = "1.95.0"
rustfmt.pkg-path = "rustfmt"
rustfmt.version = "1.95.0"

# --- Native build deps for Rust C-extension crates (from Cargo.lock) -
# pq-sys (diesel `postgres` feature) links libpq via pkg-config; the
# non-default `lib`/`dev` outputs carry libpq.so + pg_config + libpq.pc.
# postgresql_18 (matches docker-compose pg 18) also serves the DB below.
postgresql.pkg-path = "postgresql_18"
postgresql.outputs = ["out", "lib", "dev"]
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
# gcc drives the linker and builds cc/ring/zstd-sys/jemalloc crates.
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
# zstd-sys can link the system zstd; its lib/headers are non-default outputs.
zstd.pkg-path = "zstd"
zstd.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
# No openssl: Cargo.lock has no openssl-sys — TLS is rustls/ring, and the
# Dockerfile's libssl-dev sits in the runner (runtime) stage, not the builder.

# --- Node toolchain for the api_tests/ integration suite ------------
# CI runs api_tests on node:24 with pnpm; @types/node ^24, packageManager
# pnpm@10. .npmrc sets package-manager-strict=false, so a catalog pnpm is
# accepted (no corepack needed). Pinned to the newest node_24 / pnpm_10
# builds still published for all four systems — the very latest (24.18.0 /
# 10.34.5) drop x86_64-darwin, which options.systems targets.
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"
nodejs.version = "24.16.0"
pnpm.pkg-path = "pnpm_10"
pnpm.version = "10.34.0"


## Environment Variables ---------------------------------------------
[vars]
# User/database name match config/defaults.hjson + scripts/start_dev_db.sh.
# The connection URL is NOT here: it embeds the (dynamic) socket directory,
# so it is assembled in the hook below. PGHOST is exported there too.
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "lemmy"
PGDATABASE = "lemmy"
RUST_BACKTRACE = "1"


## Activation Hook ---------------------------------------------------
[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Keep Rust build artifacts out of the repo tree ---------------
  # scripts/start_dev_db.sh would put a pg cluster under ./target; here
  # both the cargo cache and the db live in the local Flox cache instead.
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/target"
  mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"

  # --- Lemmy loads config relative to cwd; anchor it to the repo root -
  export LEMMY_CONFIG_LOCATION="$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/config/config.hjson"

  # --- Translations submodule is a build input of the email crate ----
  # crates/email/build.rs reads translations/backend/ at compile time. This
  # only warns — a hook must not mutate the tracked git tree on every
  # activation, so initializing the submodule is left as a one-time step.
  if [ -z "$(ls -A "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/crates/email/translations" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "⚠  crates/email/translations is empty — the email crate will not build." >&2
    echo "   Run once:  git submodule update --init --recursive" >&2
  fi

  # --- PostgreSQL: a socket-only dev cluster (ports scripts/start_dev_db.sh) -
  # Listens on a unix socket in the Flox cache, NOT on TCP 5432 — so it never
  # collides with a postgres already running on the host. That collision is
  # exactly why start_dev_db.sh uses a socket and docker-compose maps pg to
  # 5433. auth=trust makes the ":password" in the URL a no-op.
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export PGHOST="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE"
  # libpq wants the socket directory percent-encoded in the URL host position.
  ENCODED_HOST="${PGHOST//\//%2F}"
  export DATABASE_URL="postgresql://$PGUSER:password@$ENCODED_HOST/$PGDATABASE"
  export LEMMY_DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL"
  if [ ! -f "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" --username="$PGUSER" --auth=trust --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-k $PGHOST -c listen_addresses= -p $PGPORT" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start
    tries=0
    until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q; do
      tries=$((tries + 1))
      [ "$tries" -gt 50 ] && { echo "⚠  postgres did not become ready — check $PGDATA/init.log" >&2; break; }
      sleep 0.2
    done
    createdb -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" 2>/dev/null \
      || echo "database $PGDATABASE already present" >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi
'''


## Profile script ----------------------------------------------------
[profile]
bash = 'export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"'
zsh  = 'export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"'
fish = 'set -x CARGO_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; fish_add_path "$CARGO_HOME/bin"'


## Services ----------------------------------------------------------
[services.postgres]
# Socket-only (listen_addresses empty) so it never fights a host postgres on
# 5432; the socket lives in the Flox cache. Dev-only tuning from
# scripts/start_dev_db.sh: fsync=off (safe for a throwaway db, much faster).
command = """
  exec postgres \
    -D "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres" \
    -k "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE" \
    -c listen_addresses= \
    -p "$PGPORT" \
    -c fsync=off
"""


## Other Environment Options -----------------------------------------
[options]
# Keep the environment portable across the four standard platforms.
systems = [
  "aarch64-darwin",
  "aarch64-linux",
  "x86_64-darwin",
  "x86_64-linux",
]

runs.manifest:
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
[install]
# Rust toolchain pinned to 1.95 per rust-toolchain.toml (channel = "1.95");
# workspace rust-version floor is 1.92, edition 2024. cargo/rustc/clippy at
# 1.95.0 co-resolve as one toolchain and share the default pkg-group.
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.version = "1.95.0"
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.version = "1.95.0"
clippy.pkg-path = "clippy"
clippy.version = "1.95.0"

# C toolchain + make: ring, zstd-sys, and tikv-jemalloc-sys (Cargo.lock)
# compile bundled C/asm from build scripts; gcc is also the linker.
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"

# diesel's "postgres" feature pulls pq-sys (Cargo.lock), which links libpq at
# build time — found via pkg-config. postgresql_18 matches the compose image
# (pgautoupgrade:18) and serves double duty as the [services.postgres] server.
# NOTE: NO openssl — Cargo.lock has no openssl-sys (rustls/ring everywhere);
# the Dockerfile's runner-stage libssl-dev is runtime-only, not a build dep.
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
postgresql_18.pkg-path = "postgresql_18"
# lib = libpq.so, dev = headers + libpq.pc (neither installs by default) —
# both required so pq-sys can find and link libpq.
postgresql_18.outputs = ["out", "lib", "dev"]


## Environment Variables ---------------------------------------------
[vars]
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "postgres"
PGDATABASE = "lemmy"
# Load the local config (config/config.hjson) regardless of cwd.
LEMMY_CONFIG_LOCATION = "config/config.hjson"
# NOTE: PGHOST and LEMMY_DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_URL are NOT set here — they hold
# the (dynamic) $FLOX_ENV_CACHE unix-socket path, so the hook computes and
# exports them (per "dynamic values belong in [hook]").


## Activation Hook ---------------------------------------------------
[hook]
on-activate = """
  # --- Rust: keep cargo home + build artifacts in the Flox cache, NOT the
  # repo tree. (The repo's scripts/start_dev_db.sh puts its cluster and target
  # under $PWD/target; we deliberately do not, so the working tree stays clean.)
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/target"
  mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"

  # --- PostgreSQL over a unix socket in the Flox cache. start_dev_db.sh uses a
  # socket (listen_addresses='') specifically to avoid TCP port clashes; we do
  # the same, but keep the cluster + socket in the cache instead of ./target.
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export PGHOST="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg_socket"
  mkdir -p "$PGHOST"
  # Percent-encode the socket dir for the URL (only '/' is a reserved char here),
  # exactly as start_dev_db.sh does with `jq -sRr @uri`.
  ENCODED_HOST="${PGHOST//\\//%2F}"
  export LEMMY_DATABASE_URL="postgres://lemmy:password@${ENCODED_HOST}/lemmy"
  export DATABASE_URL="$LEMMY_DATABASE_URL"

  # Sentinel guard: a cluster that failed mid-setup is torn down and retried,
  # never silently reused half-initialized.
  if [ ! -f "$PGDATA/.flox_initialized" ]; then
    rm -rf "$PGDATA"
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -w \
      -o "-c listen_addresses='' -c unix_socket_directories=$PGHOST -p $PGPORT" \
      -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start
    psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \
      -c "CREATE USER lemmy WITH PASSWORD 'password' SUPERUSER;" \
      -c "CREATE DATABASE lemmy WITH OWNER lemmy;" >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast
    touch "$PGDATA/.flox_initialized"
  fi
"""


## Profile script ----------------------------------------------------
[profile]
bash = 'export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"'
zsh  = 'export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"'
fish = 'set -x CARGO_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"; fish_add_path "$CARGO_HOME/bin"'


## Services ---------------------------------------------------------
[services.postgres]
# dev-only auth=trust cluster; unix socket in the Flox cache, no TCP.
command = """
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"

[install]
# Rust toolchain pinned to 1.95 (← rust-toolchain.toml `channel = "1.95"`,
# echoed by CI's `rust:1.95` image). clippy/rustfmt are version-locked to the
# compiler, so they carry the same pin to stay coherent with rustc (an
# unpinned rustfmt would float to 1.96 and mismatch).
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.version = "1.95.0"
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.version = "1.95.0"
clippy.pkg-path = "clippy"
clippy.version = "1.95.0"
rustfmt.pkg-path = "rustfmt"
rustfmt.version = "1.95.0"

# Postgres 18 (← docker/docker-compose.yml `pgautoupgrade:18-alpine`, CI
# `postgresql-client-18`). Serves double duty: the dev database service AND
# the libpq that the `pq-sys` crate links at build time (diesel postgres
# feature). libpq.so lives in the `lib` output and its pkg-config file in
# `dev`; neither is a default output, so request them explicitly alongside
# the server binaries (`out`).
postgresql_18.pkg-path = "postgresql_18"
postgresql_18.outputs = ["out", "lib", "dev"]

# Native build inputs. `pq-sys` finds libpq via pkg-config; `ring`,
# `zstd-sys` and `tikv-jemalloc-sys` are compiled from source (cc + make).
# No openssl: Cargo.lock has no `openssl-sys` (the `bcrypt` crate is pure
# Rust), so the Dockerfile's runner-stage libssl is not a build input.
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"

[vars]
PGUSER = "postgres"
PGDATABASE = "lemmy"
PGPORT = "5432"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Rust build + cargo caches (kept OUT of the repo tree) ------------
  # scripts/start_dev_db.sh puts its cluster under $PWD/target; we keep both
  # the cargo target dir and the pg cluster in $FLOX_ENV_CACHE so `flox
  # activate` never dirties the working tree.
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/target"
  mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"

  # --- Translations submodule (needed by crates/email/build.rs) ---------
  # build.rs does read_dir("translations/backend/") and errors if the
  # submodule is absent. We do NOT check it out here: a git-tree checkout on
  # every activation is the wrong idiom for a hook. It's a one-time repo
  # setup step — the reminder fires until it's populated.
  if [ ! -d crates/email/translations/backend ]; then
    echo "⚠  crates/email needs translations — run once: git submodule update --init" >&2
  fi

  # --- Dev Postgres over a PRIVATE unix socket --------------------------
  # No TCP (listen_addresses=''): the machine already runs postgres on :5432
  # in CI/containers, and a private socket avoids the clash — the same choice
  # scripts/start_dev_db.sh makes. lemmy reads LEMMY_DATABASE_URL (set in
  # [profile]); the socket dir is percent-encoded into that URL there.
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export PGHOST="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg-sockets"
  mkdir -p "$PGHOST"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" --username="$PGUSER" --auth=trust --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    {
      echo "listen_addresses = ''"
      echo "unix_socket_directories = '$PGHOST'"
      echo "port = $PGPORT"
    } >> "$PGDATA/postgresql.auto.conf"
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start
    tries=0
    until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q || [ "$tries" -ge 50 ]; do
      sleep 0.2; tries=$((tries + 1))
    done
    createuser -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" --superuser lemmy
    psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -q \
      -c "ALTER USER lemmy WITH PASSWORD 'password';"
    createdb -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -O lemmy "$PGDATABASE"
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast
  fi
'''

[profile]
# Sourced into the interactive shell. CARGO_HOME/PATH for cargo-installed
# bins; PGHOST + the percent-encoded socket URL so `psql`, `cargo run`,
# `cargo test` and `diesel` all reach the Flox-managed database.
bash = '''
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
  export PGHOST="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg-sockets"
  export LEMMY_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://lemmy:password@${PGHOST//\//%2F}/lemmy"
  export DATABASE_URL="$LEMMY_DATABASE_URL"
'''
zsh = '''
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
  export PGHOST="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg-sockets"
  export LEMMY_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://lemmy:password@${PGHOST//\//%2F}/lemmy"
  export DATABASE_URL="$LEMMY_DATABASE_URL"
'''
fish = '''
  set -x CARGO_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  fish_add_path "$CARGO_HOME/bin"
  set -x PGHOST "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg-sockets"
  set -x LEMMY_DATABASE_URL "postgresql://lemmy:password@"(string replace -a / %2F "$PGHOST")"/lemmy"
  set -x DATABASE_URL "$LEMMY_DATABASE_URL"
'''

[services.postgres]
# listen_addresses='' and the socket dir come from postgresql.auto.conf
# (written by the hook), so this stays a plain socket-only server.
command = '''
  exec postgres -D "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres" -k "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg-sockets" -p "$PGPORT"
'''

[options]
systems = [
  "aarch64-darwin",
  "aarch64-linux",
  "x86_64-darwin",
  "x86_64-linux",
]
